cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Unconfirmed connectionless: ACK, data-loss, flow-control, and connect/disconnect properties
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires all four properties of unconfirmed connectionless: no ACK; data loss possible; no flow control; no connect/disconnect. Naming the class alone is not enough.
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.25 marks per distinct property present (no ACK; loss possible; no flow control; no connect/disconnect). Name-only with no properties → 0.25. Cap at 1.0.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Three DLL service classes named and distinguished (3 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: unconfirmed connectionless - no ACK, loss of data possible, no flow control, no connect or disconnect.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Confirmed connectionless: ACK, data-loss, flow-control, and connect/disconnect properties
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires all four properties of confirmed connectionless: with ACK; no data loss (timeout/retransmit — duplicates or sequence errors possible); no flow control; no connect/disconnect. Naming the class alone is not enough.
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.25 marks per distinct property present (with ACK; no data loss / retransmit; no flow control; no connect/disconnect). Mention of duplicates or sequence errors from retransmit counts toward the data-loss property. Name-only → 0.25. Cap at 1.0.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Three DLL service classes named and distinguished (3 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: confirmed connectionless - with ACK, no loss of data (timeout and retransmit instead→ duplicates and sequence errors possible), no flow control, no connect or disconnect.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Connection-oriented: reliability, data-loss, flow-control, and connect/disconnect properties
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL requires all four properties of connection-oriented service: no data loss (and no duplication/sequencing errors); flow control; connect and disconnect (3-phased communication); reliable/ordered delivery relative to the other classes. Naming the class alone is not enough.
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: 0.25 marks per distinct property present (no data loss; no duplication/sequencing errors; flow control; connect/disconnect or 3-phased). Name-only → 0.25. Cap at 1.0.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: Three DLL service classes named and distinguished (3 marks)
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: connection-oriented - no data loss, duplication or sequencing errors. Instead a 3 phased communication with connect and disconnect, and flow control
